messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: Amanda Cole <amanda@luminahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Quarter-end OKR tally + QBR comms plan (draft)

Team,

Attached is my draft OKR tally for Q1 (file: Q4_OKR_tally.xlsx) plus a short comms draft we can share with execs and customers (QBR_comms_draft.md). High level asks:

1) Please review the raw tallies — I'm trying to keep scoring conservative where evidence is weak. Highlight any objective you think should move +/- 1.
2) Laura: can you add two lines on the product tradeoffs for the model quantization experiment?
3) Vivek: we may need a short escalation rationale for the objective we downgraded for Dedicated SLAs (I've annotated row 7).
4) Marissa + Stephanie: customer-facing comms needs to reflect CS/Support readiness and any anticipated ask for credits or remediation.

Timeline: aim to lock scores by EOD Monday (Apr 12) so we can finalize QBR slides Tuesday. I'll run a quick live call Monday 10:30am PT if we need final adjudication.

Attachments: [Attachment: Q4_OKR_tally.xlsx (xlsx, 120KB)], [Attachment: QBR_comms_draft.md (md, 8KB)], [Attachment: Lumina_Roadmap_Snapshot.pdf (pdf, 240KB)]

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Director, Platform Strategy
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 17:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarter-end OKR tally + QBR comms plan (draft)

Thanks Priyom — good concise draft. Quick pass from my side:

- I updated the tally sheet with an annotation on the quantization experiment (sheet: Notes -> Q-Exp). Proposal: keep it at 0.6 (partial) given throughput lift but some edge-case degradation we observed in the A/B.
- Suggested comms language change: lead with product impact (reduced latency for customer workloads) followed by mitigation items. The current first paragraph starts with operational detail; swap order.

On the Dedicated SLA downgrade (row 7) — I agree we need a short escalation note if we intend to mark it as 'Partial'. Recommended language in the doc: "Operational constraints during the ramp to new kernel set led to intermittent tail-latency regressions; mitigation plan includes kernel rollback and additional synthetic load testing."

I can't be on the Monday 10:30 call (back-to-back with recruiting interviews) but happy to do an async adjudication — I added comments in the Drive doc (link in related_links).

Laura Bennett
VP, Product
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarter-end OKR tally + QBR comms plan (draft)

Team — quick clarifying note on governance.

On the SLA/production stability objective: I'm OK with Partial but want the scoring note to include the decision path and approver list: engineering lead (Karthik), SRE (Elliot), product (Laura), and me for final sign-off. If anyone objects to that approver set we should surface now.

Also: for external comms to Lumina, keep the tone apologetic but decisive — do not pre-commit credits in the public statement. If Lumina presses, we'll handle credits via their procurement contact after we lock the remediation plan. Amanda, fyi — we will not include any dollar figures in the QBR comms at this stage.

On the scores matrix: moving one objective down requires a short note in the executive summary explaining the reweighting so the overall program score is interpretable. I added a suggested 2-line blurb to the draft under "scoring notes."

Vivek Kulkarni
Chief Operating Officer
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: Amanda Cole <amanda@luminahealth.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 12:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarter-end OKR tally + QBR comms plan (draft)

Adding CS perspective.

Amanda — appreciate the patience here. For the comms we should: 
- Offer a short timeline of remediation (2 weeks for root-cause fix, additional 2 weeks for validation).
- Provide an interim mitigation checklist customers can apply (config snippet + recommended rolling restart).
- Provide a single named CS contact for Lumina (I'm proposing: jessica@redwood.com).

Also: if we are likely to offer a goodwill credit, let's keep that a private, contract-level conversation. Public QBR should say "we're evaluating appropriate customer remedies" rather than specific amounts.

I left inline edits in QBR_comms_draft.md and a short appendix in Lumina_Roadmap_Snapshot.pdf pointing to the mitigations.

Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Quarter-end OKR tally + QBR comms plan (draft)

Thank you all — final plan and next steps below.

1) Scores: I'm locking the sheet with the following rules: any moved score needs one approving comment from Product (Laura) and SRE (Elliot) or myself. Karthik/Elliot will confirm the technical remediation path by EOD Monday.
2) Executive blurb: I'll include Vivek's 2-line scoring note in the QBR summary.
3) Customer comms: Marissa's timeline and single named contact accepted. Amanda, expect a private follow-up from CS to discuss remediation scope; we will not include credit numbers publicly.
4) QBR deck: Stephanie, please pull the finalized tallies into slide 4 and use the comms draft as slide 7.

I've attached the locked tally (renamed: Q4_OKR_tally_FINAL.xlsx) and an updated comms draft. If there are any last-minute objections raise them in the thread; otherwise I'll finalize slide assets Monday morning.
